articles.title: Someone Is Making One of Baldur's Gate 3's Most Popular Villains Romanceable
articles.summary: Baldur's Gate 3 has no shortage of romances and romantic encounters, but not everyone in Faerûn is up for a smooch. When developer Larian was still rolling out updates, fans would often ask for more romances to be added, whether it be for Jaheira or Rolan, but it was never meant to be.
body: One of the most popular requests was actually for one of Baldur's Gate 3's main villains, Gortash. Larian was very much aware of this, and actually addressed these fans in the patch notes in 2024.
"Listen, he’s a complicated guy who’s busy contemplating the minutia of death cult office politics," Larian said at the time. "Babygurl doesn’t have time to kiss."

But now, a fan is stepping up, adding the Gortash romance that so many were asking for. TikTok user Equipouet has shared some clips from the mod, which is still a work in progress. It shows the player character being invited to spend time with Gortash, played by Lucius Malfoy actor Jason Isaacs, after his coronation in Act 3, all with new dialogue and animations.

We're told that we'll be able to make our own choices when we meet Gortash, specifically whether we want to "charm him, keep him guessing, or walk away." So, if you really hate Gortash, you could also use the mod to let him down.
points: Baldur's Gate 3 has no shortage of romances and romantic encounters, but not everyone in Faerûn is up for a smooch.
One of the most popular requests was actually for one of Baldur's Gate 3's main villains, Gortash.
Larian was very much aware of this, and actually addressed these fans in the patch notes in 2024.
"Listen, he’s a complicated guy who’s busy contemplating the minutia of death cult office politics," Larian said at the time.

articles.title: This Star Wars Vehicles Encyclopedia Is Surprisingly Cheap For Black Friday
articles.summary: If you've been enjoying Star Wars Galactic Racer, this book is perfect for you. The Star Wars Complete Vehicles (new edition) is currently on sale at Amazon for Black Friday, and it's at its lowest price we've seen. Pick up the hardcover book for $17.30, down from its $40 sticker price.
body: Written by longtime Star Wars archivists Pablo Hidalgo and Jason Fry with illustrations by Richard Chasemore, the Star Wars Complete Vehicles hardcover book is a 264-page visual collection of virtually every ship, fighter, speeder, and other vehicles seen throughout the vast Star Wars universe. Each vehicle entry is an extremely detailed breakdown of the ins, outs, and mechanics of each vessel, with in-depth descriptions of parts, functions, lore, history, and even manufacturers.

Everything from X-Wings and podracers to TIE Fighters and even the Death Star's weaponry are displayed in great detail if you've ever been curious about how these machines function. Every era in the Star Wars universe is explored as well, so you'll see detailed markups of Clone Wars-era Republic Gunships and even Poe Dameron's X-Wing from the time of the First Order.

It's the perfect time to check this out with how popular Star Wars Galactic Racer has been since it came out a few months ago. We gave it 8 out of 10 in our review, thanks to its fast and frenetic racing mechanics and Roguelite setup.
Myles Obenza is a freelance writer for IGN. Follow him on Bluesky @mylesobenza.bsky.social.

articles.title: Xbox Game Pass Kicks Off December With Horror, Cozy Adventures, And More
articles.summary: One last month of 2026 brings two more waves of Xbox Game Pass titles to close out the year. Subscribers can once again look forward to some new arrivals in the Xbox Game Pass library, ranging from gruesome co-op action to wholesome adventures featuring helpful mice on a mission.
body: For now, you can look forward to an eclectic mix of games, starting with The Outlast Trials. Released in 2024, it’s a co-op survival-horror game that throws a team of up to four players into a gauntlet of deadly trials, where evasion is key to victory. You can also play it solo, and if the onslaught of festive season cheerfulness is getting to you, then this will be a nice–but brutal–change of pace.

If you’d prefer to focus on the coziness of the season, then Hela: Of Mice and Magic looks like a fun time. Set in a magical forest inspired by Scandinavian lands, the game follows a group of mice on a journey to help people, at the behest of an old witch who can’t make the trip herself. This is also a day-one release for Xbox Game Pass, and it’ll be joined by World of Tanks Blitz on the same day. On December 3, Freestyle Football 2 launches, bringing fast-paced, 5v5 multiplayer street soccer to Xbox and PC, and on December 14, you can grab Nubby’s Number Factory, a roguelite game all about making big numbers.

articles.title: Despite Take-Two Takedown, Vibecoding Teen Behind Nuked GTA 6 PC Port Project 'Leonida' Vows to Continue
articles.summary: The 15-year-old vibecoder behind a GTA 6 PC port project Take-Two recently shut down has vowed to continue their work despite the potential for further action from the company.
body: ‘NotRexed’ is behind ‘Project Leonida,’ which was at one point leading the race to create a PC port of GTA 6 following the recent leak of an Xbox build. Cyberleek, the infamous leaker behind many early GTA 6 gameplay clips, reportedly released the Xbox build of GTA 6 last week, and vibecoders have been attempting to port the game to PC since.

Fueled by AI, progress has been swift, with clips showing GTA 6 running on PC at a higher frame rate than on console, and one video even showing basic multiplayer. Obviously, Rockstar Games, which will no doubt release GTA 6 on PC officially at some point, and parent company Take-Two will be watching the homebrew scene’s every move like a hawk.

In the case of Project Leonida, Take-Two has already taken action. NotRexed was organizing and sharing work on a Discord group, and hosting their findings on a GitHub repository, when cease and desists from Take-Two hauled everything offline. NotRexed then took to social media to announce they'd decided to call it a day.
points: The 15-year-old vibecoder behind a GTA 6 PC port project Take-Two recently shut down has vowed to continue their work despite the potential for further action from the company.

articles.title: At last, I've finally played Faraway, an enigma I've been waiting 16 years to see
articles.summary: For 16 years I've been watching the skies. It was 16 years ago, back in the first giddy rush of smartphone gaming, that I saw a 30-second trailer for a game set in space. It was a game about a comet, hurtling through the unknown.
body: Faraway is one of those wonderfully cludged together childhood words, like "nonesuch". Where is the edge of the galaxy? Oh, it's faraway. Where is the edge of the universe? Oh, there's nonesuch thing.

Okay, Faraway came with one other bit of info I could cling to at the time. It was being made by Steph Thirion, a musician and designer and, I sensed, many other things too. At the time Faraway was announced I'd just played his game Eliss, which was an early smartphone hit. In the absence of any more information on Faraway itself, I had to make do with that. Maybe Faraway would be a bit like Eliss?

Eliss itself, though? Oh, boy. This thing is beautiful, frantic, strange, compelling and indescribable. And think what that means, just for a second, for something to be both compelling and indescribable. I am driven to do these things, but I don't really know what these things are. I'm prodding little bits of colour around, maybe planets, maybe molecules? I am combining them, gathering them, turning them into something greater together than they are by themselves?
points: It was 16 years ago, back in the first giddy rush of smartphone gaming, that I saw a 30-second trailer for a game set in space.
It was a game about a comet, hurtling through the unknown.
Faraway is one of those wonderfully cludged together childhood words, like "nonesuch".
At the time Faraway was announced I'd just played his game Eliss, which was an early smartphone hit.

articles.title: Are you a warlock tired of being summon-kicked in World of Warcraft: Forever? There's now a mod to fight back with
articles.summary: Being recruited to a World of Warcraft party as a warlock, only to be swiftly kicked again after using your powers to magically summon the party members together in the same place, may soon become a thing of the past. All thanks to a mod made by one especially peeved warlock.
body: The practice of exploiting warlocks in this way is called summon-kicking, and aside from the in-game reporting feature, there is little recourse to admonish such behavior.
Enter Summoners Union, the add-on mod, which grants the ability to flag and track players who summon-kick thereby building a collective case against them.

The mod was showcased on the World of Warcraft: Forever Reddit by user 274Moons, highlighting its ability to flag players after they boot you from a party, but also that it warns you if anyone in the party has a record of summon-kicking. It can also be combined with an in-game chat channel where warlock comrades can pull together and discuss and ultimately maybe fend off this nasty behavior.

"I play a lock and got tired of the usual 'hey can you summon?', ten minutes at the stone, last person comes through, *You have been removed from the group.*," 274Moons wrote. "So I made an addon about it. It's called The Summoners Union."

articles.title: Illumination Takes Over Macy’s Parade With New Not Alone Thanksgiving Teaser
articles.summary: There's no doubt that 2026 has been a great year for Illumination. It had one of the biggest releases of the year with The Super Mario Galaxy Movie in April, earning over $1 billion. Then, in June, it released another hit Minion movie, Minions & Monsters, which made $531 million.
body: In late June, Illumination announced its next animated feature film, Not Alone, with a trailer that unveiled a one-of-a-kind sci-fi rom-com. With its April 2027 release date fast approaching, Illumination has begun promoting Not Alone. It began with a Thanksgiving Day Parade promotional teaser, which gave us a better look at the Pikmin-like alien creatures that crash-landed on Earth in the first trailer.

Not Alone follows Joe, an introverted rocket mechanic voiced by Timothée Chalamet ( Marty Supreme, Dune ), as his romance with astrobotanist Fran, played by Selena Gomez ( Only Murders in the Building, Hotel Transylvania ), blossoms while they build a rocket ship together at work. Their budding romance is interrupted by small, colorful, humanoid aliens.​​​​​​​ Out of all the places on Earth, their space voyage ends at Joe's house, where he is forced to deal with their presence.

articles.title: Magic: The Gathering’s Most Notorious Vampire Almost Broke Commander
articles.summary: Most Commanders in Magic: The Gathering have to show up on the battlefield before they can do anything. But Edgar Markov can make you the most dangerous player at the table while he’s still sitting in the Command Zone.
body: Nine years after his debut in Commander 2017, Edgar ranks second on EDHREC, with more than 52,000 decks tracked over the past two years. Given his Eminence ability, which Wizards itself has admitted was a mistake, it's easy to see why.

While most people spend Black Friday buying presents for the holidays, we at Polygon celebrate all things vampire and vampire-adjacent with Fangsgiving. So let’s talk about the guy who sired an entire plane’s worth of vampires and then became one of Magic: The Gathering’s most lethal (and controversial) Commanders.

Magic actually introduced Edgar’s grandson first. Sorin Markov debuted as a mono-black vampire planeswalker in 2009’s Zendikar, where he had unfinished business with the Eldrazi he’d helped imprison thousands of years prior. Two years after that, Innistrad took players to Sorin's home plane. In Wizards of the Coast’s A Planeswalker’s Guide to Innistrad, a description of a hilltop estate in Stensia casually identifies its owner as Edgar Markov, Sorin’s grandfather. The guide also connects Edgar to the ritual that gave rise to Innistrad’s original 12 vampire bloodlines.
points: Most Commanders in Magic: The Gathering have to show up on the battlefield before they can do anything.
But Edgar Markov can make you the most dangerous player at the table while he’s still sitting in the Command Zone.

articles.title: 5 Years Later, an Avengers: Doomsday Hero's Next MCU Adventure Is Finally Moving Forward
articles.summary: Shang-Chi is getting ready to return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe in Avengers: Doomsday, but fans hoping to see more of the hero have another reason to be optimistic.
body: Speaking on the Escape Hatch podcast, Callaham, whose writing credits include Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse and Mortal Kombat, said the project is still in its early stages, but that there is "some real movement." He added that he was happy to share the news. Callaham didn't offer details about the story or say when the movie might go into production.

Marvel first announced a sequel in December 2021, with director Destin Daniel Cretton ( Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Wonder Man ) expected to return. Cretton co-wrote and directed the original film, but has since taken on other projects, including the announced Naruto live-action movie. In the years since the sequel was announced, Marvel has shared few concrete details about its development. Cretton has previously said the project remained in development and pointed to the disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic as a factor in the delay.

Callaham's update is encouraging news​​​​​​​, but Marvel has not announced a release date, production schedule, or further casting. Still, hearing from one of the original film's writers that work is underway is a meaningful step forward after five years of uncertainty.
points: Shang-Chi is getting ready to return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe in Avengers: Doomsday, but fans hoping to see more of the hero have another reason to be optimistic.

articles.title: Marvelous, developer of the Story of Seasons series, opens up voluntary redundancy scheme as it seeks to reduce headcount by 65 employees
articles.summary: Marvelous, the studio known for its work on the Story of Seasons series as well as the upcoming Eternal Anima, has announced the introduction of a voluntary redundancy scheme. Through this program, it's aiming to lower its headcount by 65 employees.
body: Per Automaton, this "early retirement" program is part of an effort to restructure its console business, which refers to non-mobile, non-live-service games under its umbrella.

The reason for this change is the shifting environment in game development, namely the growing scope of development and elongated development cycles. The company cites a need to optimise its workforce and shift towards flexibility, per the introduction of the early retirement program.

Marvelous will begin gathering applications, with those choosing to take the company up on the offer set to leave at the end of the financial year in March 2027. These employees will receive a bonus as part of their redundancy package, as well as assistance finding new employment elsewhere if they desire it.

Marvelous emphasised that despite this program, it still sees console game development as one of its core businesses. This comes in the same financial year Marvelous reported a 1,105 percent increase in profit between April 2026 - September 2026, credited to overseas sales of both new indie releases and older console games.
points: Marvelous, the studio known for its work on the Story of Seasons series as well as the upcoming Eternal Anima, has announced the introduction of a voluntary redundancy scheme.

articles.title: Drone Pilots have come to Cyber Knights: Flashpoint, the stealth tactics game's "most complex" class yet, alongside a pet system and the promise of "assassin cats"
articles.summary: How dare you accuse me of being a friendless loser! I have loads of friends! Their names are R2-D2 and Clippy and Arnold and Rosie the Maid. They all live in my rucksack, ready and waiting should I need somebody to dupe a security guard or fill the air around me with explosive chaff.
body: With friends like these, who needs human allies? It's time to play stealth tactics sim Cyber Knights: Flashpoint the way it was meant to be played: skulking in a hole while buzzing, clanking mechabastards cleanse the map of any and all defenders. Don't spare the lead, Rosie. You were not built to understand mercy.

Drones come in three types, light (fast and best for stealthy support), medium (a mix of support and combat-oriented), and heavy (flying forts and/or stomping murder mechs). Light or medium drones are deployed from your backpack, and auto-extract when you do, no matter where they are. Heavy drones deploy alongside you at mission start, and have to be within nine metres of you when you extract, potentially trapping you on the map. Each drone chassis has its own weapon and armour setup, plus a choice of modules that grant Talents (abilities).

videos.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition – Overview Trailer
videos.summary: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition will be available on December 3, 2026. Pre-orders are available now on Nintendo eShop:
body: Experience the epic tale of life and interconnected futures, now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system! The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of this game features improved visuals, sharper cutscenes, the new mode Heroes' Vault, and more. Plus, meet the new Hero, Shimmer, and wield her Foresight ability.
Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Xenoblade Chronicles 3 on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by purchasing the upgrade pack.
Visit Nintendo.com for more info:

videos.title: Bad Inmate - Release Date Announcement Trailer | PS VR Games
videos.summary: Bad Inmate is coming to PlayStation VR2 on December 10, 2026!
body: Get ready for a hilarious, physics-driven VR prison sandbox where breaking the rules is just the beginning! Sneak past guards, steal keys, prank inmates, and turn everyday objects into ridiculous escape tools.

Dig your way out with a spoon, uncover hidden secrets, and improvise your own chaotic escape plans. Every object is an opportunity, every decision can backfire, and no two escape attempts have to be the same.
Think you have what it takes to break free?
